subject: Follow-up: reserved capacity sizing & unit-econ for Pritech (H100 vs A100)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Adler <madler@pritech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: reserved capacity sizing & unit-econ for Pritech (H100 vs A100)

Hi Michael — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call summary (30m):
- Workload: document summarization + retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for customer support. Average prompt+response ~850 tokens.
- Current production target: 10M tokens/month in Q3 ramp, 50M by Q4, long-term steady-state 200M/mo.
- SLA: 95th pct latency target ~300ms for small completions; burst tolerance for large batches.

Sizing / throughput notes we discussed:
- Baseline throughput assumptions per GPU (estimate):
  - H100 (reserved, optimized kernels): ~120k tokens/sec sustained (approx 7.2M tokens/min) under our continuous-batching profile.
  - A100 (p4/p40 family): ~55k tokens/sec sustained (approx 3.3M tokens/min).
- For the 50M/mo medium case, we estimated needing ~1-2 H100-equivalent lanes (with autoscale burst) or ~3-4 A100 lanes to keep latency SLOs.
- For 200M/mo steady-state, 3–4 H100 lanes or ~10 A100 lanes (depending on quantization + batch mix).

Unit-econ / pricing guidance (initial anchor):
- Target unit price: customer asked for a $/1M-tokens target. We discussed a target range of $6–$9 per 1M tokens for H100 reserved lanes (volume & 12–24mo commit dependent). A100 lanes land ~25–40% higher per-1M-token due to lower throughput and more GPUs required.
- Example bands (ballpark, subject to final benchmarking + contract):
  - 10M/mo: $18–$45k/mo range (higher per-1M since small volume).
  - 50M/mo: aim $6–$10 per 1M tokens (negotiated band).
  - 200M/mo: $4.5–$7 per 1M tokens (volume discount + reserved lanes).

Attachments: sent a small benchmark summary and a draft estimate (attached).

Action items / asks from Pritech:
1) Confirm preferred GPU family (H100 if they favor latency/cost; A100 if procurement constraints).
2) Confirm short-term volume expectation for Q3 (10M vs 50M).
3) Procurement contact (copied Sarah?) to flag if PoC quote needs special terms.

Next steps (Redwood):
- We will: produce a formal two-option quote (H100 reserved lanes vs A100 reserved lanes) including per-1M token price anchors, 12/24 month commit tiers, and estimated throughput per lane.
- Proposed deadline: draft quote by EOD Fri (2026-06-05).
- Book a short follow-up to review quote and procurement asks — suggest Tue 6/9 10am PT.

Thanks — feel free to flag anything missing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- price_estimate_pritech_v1.pdf (pdf, 2 pages)
- gpu-benchmark.csv (csv, 1 page)
From: Michael Adler <madler@pritech.com>

Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: reserved capacity sizing & unit-econ for Pritech (H100 vs A100)

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Volume profile: Q3 pilot will be closer to 5–10M tokens (mostly phased feature flag), Q4 is our real ramp and we expect 40–60M if things look good. 200M is a stretch target for next year.
2) Throughput: our internal perf team cares about sustained throughput for near-realtime assistants. Can you confirm the sustained tokens/min figure per H100 lane for the 850-token average response? You mentioned bursts — but sustained numbers are most important for cost modeling.
3) Budget: procurement has signaled a target of ~ $8 / 1M tokens for initial commit; if your H100 band can get to $6–7 at 50M/mo that's attractive. For A100 the higher ratio is a blocker unless there are strong discounts.

Also please cc our procurement lead Sarah (copied) — she will need the formal quote + any specific terms (termination, data retention) to circulate.

We can do Tue 6/9 10am PT for the quote walkthrough.

-Michael
Michael Adler
Head of Product
Pritech
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: reserved capacity sizing & unit-econ for Pritech (H100 vs A100)

Michael — quick technical confirmation and two pricing options attached.

Sustained throughput (850-token avg):
- H100 (optimized stack, continuous batching, KV cache warm): ~420k tokens/min sustained (~7k tokens/sec) when running mixed prompt sizes and ~10% system overhead. That maps to ≈6.5M tokens/hour per H100 lane. We used a conservative sustained number of 400k/min in the estimate.
- A100: ~195k tokens/min sustained under same profile.

Pricing options (attached PDF):
- Option A (H100-priority): 2 reserved H100 lanes for pilot -> scales to 3 lanes at 50M/mo, price anchor $7 / 1M tokens at 50M/mo with 12mo commit; $6 / 1M for 24mo. Includes KV cache, basic routing, and 99.9% uptime SLA for compute.
- Option B (A100-economy): 4 reserved A100 lanes, price anchor $9.5 / 1M at 50M/mo with 12mo commit. Slightly higher unit price due to lower throughput.

Notes: pricing assumes input+output tokens counted; embedding costs are separate. We included a small PoC credit line for the pilot month to reduce upfront friction.

Attaching the price_estimate_pritech_v1.pdf and the benchmark CSV for your procurement review.

If you want, we can also show a hybrid configuration (H100 burst pool + A100 baseline) that sometimes yields better blended unit economics for bursty workloads.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
